verdict.rationale: Synthesia is an AI video creation tool, so in-tool sound effects, ambient audio, or music is a fair question for it. The evidence only documents AI voiceovers, voice cloning, lip-sync dubbing and uploading custom script audio. Nothing shows generated sound effects, ambient audio, or scene-matched music, and narration or uploaded speech audio is a different capability that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a creator, I can add generated sound effects, ambient audio, or music matched to the scene in the same tool
